title: A Treatise on Atonement
author: hosea-ballou
attributionNote: Written by Hosea Ballou, a central early American Universalist theologian.
description: Ballou’s treatise argued for universal salvation and reworked traditional accounts of atonement and divine justice. It became a foundational text of American Universalism.
historicalContext: Published in 1805 during the formative period of American Universalist institutions. Its arguments were debated within and beyond Universalist circles.
availabilityNote: Catalogue record only. A verified public-domain edition has not yet been imported.
